components.name: typed defect certificate composition calculus
components.project_addition: Defines a fail-closed composition contract across functional, p-adic module/group-defect, semiring-weighted and MAY-support certificates. Arbitrary source coarsening always composes at MAY level by reverse-graph relational composition. Nested linear target defects fit a short exact sequence with chain-additive exponent mass, but invariant profiles require extension data. Strong certificates may demote along verified erasure maps; automatic upward lifting is prohibited without explicit reconstruction witnesses.
